title: Continuous 3D Spatial Transcriptomics Reconstruction via Histology-Informed Implicit Neural Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.14129v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Three-dimensional spatial transcriptomics (3D ST) enables the analysis of gene-expression patterns across tissue depths. However, 3D ST measurements are acquired from discrete 2D tissue sections, which are often sparsely sampled due to high acquisition costs. To address this limitation, we propose a histology-informed multi-task implicit neural representation (HIM-INR) for continuous 3D gene-expression reconstruction from sparse ST observations. HIM-INR jointly reconstructs gene-expression profiles and histological representations using an INR with a shared backbone, leveraging densely sampled histological images as auxiliary spatial supervision. Once trained, HIM-INR predicts gene expression at arbitrary 3D coordinates without requiring histological images. Experiments on two 3D ST datasets demonstrate improved reconstruction over existing methods, particularly as the number of missing ST sections increases.

translated_title: 基于组织学信息引导的隐式神经表示的连续三维空间转录组学重建
translated_abstract: 三维空间转录组学（3D ST）能够分析跨组织深度的基因表达模式。然而，3D ST的测量是从离散的二维组织切片中获取的，且由于采集成本高昂，这些切片通常采样稀疏。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种组织学信息引导的多任务隐式神经表示方法（HIM-INR），用于从稀疏的ST观测中进行连续的三维基因表达重建。HIM-INR使用具有共享骨干网络的隐式神经表示，联合重建基因表达谱和组织学表示，并利用密集采样的组织学图像作为辅助空间监督。训练完成后，HIM-INR无需组织学图像即可预测任意三维坐标处的基因表达。在两个3D ST数据集上的实验表明，与现有方法相比，该方法在重建方面有所改进，尤其是在缺失ST切片数量增加的情况下表现更为突出。
tldr: 提出了一种组织学信息引导的多任务隐式神经表示方法HIM-INR，通过共享骨干网络联合重建基因表达谱和组织学表示，并利用密集采样的组织学图像作为辅助监督，实现了从稀疏空间转录组学观测到任意三维坐标的连续基因表达重建。
en_tdlr: HIM-INR, a histology-informed multi-task implicit neural representation with a shared backbone, leverages densely sampled histological images as auxiliary supervision to enable continuous 3D gene-expression reconstruction at arbitrary coordinates from sparse spatial transcriptomics observations.
